        <div class="code-card-header">
          <span class="dot"></span>
          <span class="dot"></span>
          <span class="dot"></span>
          <span class="filename">example.py</span>
        </div>
        <pre><code><span class="im">import</span> numpy <span class="im">as</span> np
<span class="im">from</span> dyf <span class="im">import</span> DensityClassifier

<span class="cm"># Your embeddings</span>
embeddings <span class="op">=</span> np.random.<span class="fn">randn</span>(
    <span class="dv">10000</span>, <span class="dv">384</span>
).<span class="fn">astype</span>(np.float32)

<span class="cm"># Find structure</span>
clf <span class="op">=</span> <span class="fn">DensityClassifier</span>(
    embedding_dim<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">384</span>
)
clf.<span class="fn">fit</span>(embeddings)

<span class="cm"># What did we find?</span>
<span class="nb">print</span>(clf.<span class="fn">report</span>())</code></pre>
      </div>

      <div class="text">
        <h3>How it works</h3>
        <p>DYF uses a two-stage PCA-based LSH to classify every item in your corpus.</p>
        <ol class="steps">
          <li><strong>Random hashing</strong> <span>— L2 normalize, project onto random hyperplanes, form coarse buckets</span></li>
          <li><strong>Learn semantics</strong> <span>— PCA on bucket centroids discovers the real directions in your data</span></li>
          <li><strong>Re-hash</strong> <span>— Re-hash all items with semantic hyperplanes for clean, meaningful buckets</span></li>
        </ol>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

    <h2>Built for real workflows</h2>

      <div class="feature-card">
        <h3>Semantic Navigation</h3>
        <p>Find paths between concepts through bridge items that connect distant clusters.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feature-card" style="outline: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.45); outline-offset: -1px; position: relative; z-index: 1;">
        <h3>Structure Discovery</h3>
        <p>Understand how your data organizes itself without imposing external taxonomies.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feature-card">
        <h3>Anomaly Detection</h3>
        <p>Identify orphans that don't belong anywhere and bridges that span multiple domains.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feature-card">
        <h3>Index Building</h3>
        <p>Pre-compute hierarchical structure for fast approximate nearest-neighbor queries.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feature-card">
        <h3>RAG Re-ranking</h3>
        <p>Diversity-aware re-ranking that boosts items spanning clusters for richer retrieval.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feature-card">
        <h3>DataFrame I/O</h3>
        <p>Works directly with Polars and Pandas. Classify from DataFrames, export results back.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
